featured_reviews.name: Sarah Penkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a member at Anytime Fitness for about five months now, and I can genuinely say this has been one of the best fitness decisions I’ve made.

The facility is exceptionally well-maintained. The workout areas are clean, spacious, and organized, and the washrooms and locker rooms are hygienic and spotless. I also really appreciate the emphasis on safety, including surveillance near the locker area, which makes the environment feel secure.

What has truly made the biggest difference for me is my trainer, Niharika ma’am. I’ve never been very consistent with gyms before, but she is understanding, friendly, and extremely supportive. If there are exercises I’m interested in, she thoughtfully incorporates them, so it feels like a collaborative effort rather than one-way instruction. For women looking to lose weight while preserving muscle mass (including those managing PCOS) I would highly recommend her. She also provides helpful diet guidance tailored to your goals.

I’d also like to mention Khyati ma’am for managing everything so efficiently. The entire staff is polite, helpful, and welcoming, which makes the overall experience even better.

In the last five months, I’ve lost around 9–10 kgs, and I’m excited to continue working toward my fitness goals. I would definitely recommend Anytime Fitness to friends and family.

featured_reviews.name: Juhi Banga
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training with Prince at Anytime Fitness Malad, for about 5 months now, and I couldn’t have asked for a better trainer. My fitness journey has had many ups and downs due to illness, travel, and sciatica, but Prince has been endlessly patient, encouraging, and motivating. His patience and positivity genuinely make me look forward to every session.

He has excellent knowledge of form and technique, knows how to push me without overwhelming me, and tracks my progress closely while encouraging me to stay consistent. Every session is thoughtful, personalised, and aligned with my goals.

What I value most is that he supports me not just physically but emotionally too. He listens, motivates, and has genuinely become a good friend. I feel stronger, more confident, and more committed because of his guidance.

Highly recommend Prince to anyone looking for a dedicated, knowledgeable, and truly supportive trainer.

featured_reviews.review_text:

She is incredibly attentive and focused, always offering personalized adjustments and modifications to ensure everyone, regardless of their skill level, feels supported and gets the most out of the session. Her classes are the perfect blend of challenging and deeply restorative. Rachna creates such a welcoming and positive environment that makes my gym visits genuinely enjoyable.
If you're looking for an amazing yoga teacher in the area, look no further than Rachna Jain! Highly recommend her classes.

I can confidently say that training with prince sir has been one of the best decisions of my life. Before I started, I struggled with motivation, consistency, and knowing what was right for my body. But from day one, he brought a level of energy, positivity, and dedication that completely transformed my mindset.

He didn’t just guide me through workouts  he motivated me, believed in me, and pushed me to become the strongest version of myself.
